description: What THIS company actually has installed — built-in and organisation-built (custom) extensions alike. This is the answer to 'which extensions do I have', 'is WooCommerce turned on for me', 'what am I paying for'. Not to be confused with get_extension_catalog, which lists what exists on the platform whether or not this merchant has it. Each row carries `extensionId` (pass this to install_extension / uninstall_extension) and `companyExtensionId` (the install record itself — you never need to pass that one). `description` is filled in only for custom extensions; built-in ones store no prose, so do not guess what they do. LIMITATION: the install date is not stored — you cannot say when an extension was added or who added it. To answer what an installed extension CHANGED in the cabinet — a new menu entry, a block on a detail page — use get_extension_surfaces.
name: hub_get_installed_extensions
title: List installed extensions
